policy: A gate may be passed or waived only with non-sensitive evidence references and named review metadata.

gates.title: Staging HTTP, cache, compression, and proxy verification
gates.required_evidence: Record staging header checks for immutable assets, private API and guest-order responses, public robots/sitemap/RSS cache and ETag/304 behavior, CORS, Brotli or gzip, TLS, reverse-proxy behavior, and a browser trace proving partial guest-filter payloads.

gates.title: Production-like MySQL/MariaDB query plans
gates.required_evidence: Attach EXPLAIN ANALYZE evidence for chat previews, notifications, events, event-scoped file counts and paginated workspaces, outbox, mobile-push, athlete daily flow, role-scoped team home, privacy-scoped training-log visibility, plan- and event-linked route visibility, consent-scoped recruiting profile matches and recruiting conversations, refund-ledger locking, atomic payout assignment and chunked payout-candidate loading plus all four additive workflow migrations, consent-filtered product analytics, public club/sport/city discovery, sponsor trust filters, and bounded 28-day sponsor outcome aggregates plus the online-DDL rollout plan.

gates.title: SMTP, Firebase, Stripe, and PayPal smoke tests
gates.required_evidence: Provide sandbox or staging delivery, webhook signature, refund idempotency, retry, local-state isolation on provider failure, partial/full refund, credit-note, payout assignment, paid transition and reconciliation evidence for every enabled provider.

gates.title: External SLO dashboards and alerts
gates.required_evidence: Link privacy-safe dashboards and tested alerts for availability, API errors, latency, queues, webhooks, mail, push, and backups.

gates.title: Android and iOS real-device acceptance
gates.required_evidence: Attach signed-build or TestFlight evidence for login, logout, secure token restore, push, event-scoped file upload/read-only access/protected preview, deep links, RTL, route-to-training and route-to-event selection/navigation, prefilled event training logs, event start/finish display, recruiting sport-profile sharing and separate chat consent, recruiting chat and membership handoff, refund duplicate-submit protection, payout preparation/payment, currency display and adjustment/recovery visibility, GPS-track ownership handling, and core workflows on real devices.

gates.title: Native-language and Arabic RTL review
gates.required_evidence: Record native DE/EN/FR/AR review, semantic back-translation, overflow and keyboard/screen-reader checks, and Arabic RTL visual acceptance on critical routes including public guest navigation and filters, privacy consent, recruiting profile sharing and assistive match explanations, refund/payout reconciliation, and product analytics.

gates.title: Human WCAG 2.2 AA and assistive-technology acceptance
gates.required_evidence: Record keyboard-only, NVDA or JAWS, VoiceOver, 200/400-percent zoom, reflow, forced-colors, reduced-motion, focus-not-obscured, status-message and touch-target review for all five critical journeys and representative guest pages in DE/EN/FR/AR including Arabic RTL. Attach severity, owner and target date for every residual finding plus approval of the accessibility statement.

gates.title: Version-bound legal and privacy approval
gates.required_evidence: Record approval of provider identity, terms, privacy notices, separate product analytics consent/version, retention rules, and store privacy declarations for the exact release version.

gates.title: DSGVO DPIA and processing governance
gates.required_evidence: Provide the approved DPIA, records of processing, processor inventory, product analytics purpose/KPI and minimum-group approval, deletion/export exercises, purpose limits, and incident contacts.

gates.title: Independent penetration test
gates.required_evidence: Attach the independent web, API, mobile, authorization, upload, payment, and tenant-isolation assessment plus closure evidence for critical findings.

gates.title: Three-to-five-club pilot acceptance
gates.required_evidence: Record onboarding, migration, support, active-use, billing, training, and administration outcomes for three to five representative pilot clubs.
